label: Search
description: Discovers declaratively contributed Search providers and aggregates their results without maintaining a central index.

searchProviderDescriptor.description: Frozen lightweight metadata for one configured Search provider; listing it does not load the provider implementation.

prefixes.description: Frozen list of case-insensitive leading prefixes. Empty when the provider defines no prefixes.

searchProviderDescriptorList.description: Frozen Search provider descriptors in effective configuration order.

searchResult.description: Serializable navigation result uniquely identified by providerId and id.

searchOptions.description: Provider selection, aggregate limit, and cooperative cancellation options.

providers.description: Known provider IDs to select. With a recognized prefix, only providers also declaring that prefix are selected.

signal.description: Optional AbortSignal used for cooperative cancellation.

searchResponse.description: Aggregated successful results and sanitized provider failures.

listProviders.description: Synchronously lists defensive provider metadata without loading or constructing provider implementations.

query.description: Searches the selected providers and deduplicates results within the aggregate limit. A recognized prefix alone requests unfiltered discovery in provider order. Blank input returns an empty response.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Search text with an optional provider prefix, or a recognized prefix alone to list available results.
